P.name: Shepherd of Souls
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Final Service:}} Whenever '''Yorick''' uses ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}'' to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he raises a ''grave'' at {{tt|their location|Grave is spawned on top of the killed enemy and within close proximity of the damaged champion or monster}}. Additionally, a grave is passively raised for every {{pp|8th;7th;6th;5th;4th;3rd;2nd|1;3;5;7;9;11;13}} enemy that dies otherwise near him. Up to 4 ''graves'' can exist at once, lasting until '''Yorick''' exits the general area or {{tip|death|dies}}, with the furthest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.
P.description2: '''Yorick''' can use ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}'' and ''{{ais|Mourning Mist|Yorick}}'' mark to raise 1 {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each ''grave'' after a 1-second delay, consuming the ''graves'' in the process.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - The Cursed Horde:}} Up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} can be active at once near '''Yorick''' or near '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|The Maiden|nolink=true}}''', with the nearest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.

Q.name: Last Rites
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and {{tip|heal}} him. The heal is reduced by 50% against non-champions.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 110}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}}}
{{st|Heal|{{pp|8+2*x for 6; then +3*x for 6; then +5*x for 8|formula = 8 + 2 per level until 6, then + 3 per level until 12, then + 5 per level}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6 to 10}}% of his '''missing''' health)}}|Non-Champion Heal|{{pp|8/2+2/2*x for 6; then +3/2*x for 6; then +5/2*x for 8|formula = 4 + 1 per level until 6, then + 1.5 per level until 12, then + 2.5 per level}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6*0.5 to 10*0.5}}% of his '''missing''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: While there are at least 3 ''graves'' nearby and ''Last Rites'' is active or on {{sti|cooldown}}, '''Yorick''' can cast ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}''.
Q.description3: ''Last Rites {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Yorick's''' basic attack timer.''

Q.name: Awakening
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' exhumes a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} under his command from each nearby ''grave''.

W.name: Dark Procession
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' summons a ring of spirits around the target location that arises after a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} enemies hit by the walls over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, though not through terrain. Within {{tt|210-units|Estimated}}, they are pulled inside; otherwise they are pushed away. The ring remains for 4 seconds as impassible [[terrain]] against enemies, granting {{tip|sight}} inside the ring.
W.description2: ''Dark Procession'' can only be targeted by enemy {{tip|champion}} basic attacks and {{tip|turrets}}. The wall takes 1 [[damage]] per attack from champions and is destroyed instantly from turret attacks.

E.name: Mourning Mist
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' hurls a globule of Black Mist that splashes across an area at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, down to a minimum threshold against {{tip|minions}}, and capped against {{tip|monsters}}. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and marked as ''Cursed'' for 4 seconds.
E.description2:
{{sbc|Cursed:}} The target is {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}}, and continually raises a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each nearby ''grave'', up to a maximum of 4.

'''Yorick''', {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} and the '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|The Maiden|nolink=true}}''' gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby ''Cursed'' enemies. {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} will {{tip|dash|leap}} to nearby ''Cursed'' enemy champions and large monsters once, attacking them upon arrival.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|13 to 25}}% of target's armor}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|18 to 30}}%}}

R.name: Eulogy of the Isles
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' summons the '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|nolink=true}}''' {{tt|over {{fd|1.5}} seconds|From the start of the cast time; summons become alive 1 second after cast.}}, along with a number of {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} surrounding her at the target location, which remain on the battlefield until she or '''Yorick''' dies. ''Eulogy of the Isles'' can be recast once while the ''Maiden'' is alive after 10 seconds of the activation.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Yorick''' sets the ''Maiden'' free, allowing her to push the nearest [[lanes|lane]] until she dies.
R.description3: ''See [[Yorick#Pets|Pets]] for more details about The '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|nolink=true}}'''.''
